panels.title: Hicky's Bengal Gazette in colonial education and press
ascii_lines: FOCUS -> Hicky's Bengal Gazette
EVIDENCE -> Hicky's Bengal Gazette began in 1780 and is treated as India's first newspaper.
EXAM USE -> use Hicky's Bengal Gazette to match actor, date, mechanism and limit.
LIMIT -> do not transfer Hicky's Bengal Gazette to another institution or theatre.
MUST REMEMBER: The 1813 education grant, Macaulay's 1835 Minute, Wood's Dispatch of 1854 and
the 1857 universities mark different policy stages, while press controls repeatedly
tightened and relaxed.
